sentences.text: The second season of Fargo , an American anthology black comedy -- crime drama television series created by Noah Hawley , premiered on October 12 , 2015 , on the basic cable network FX .	FX	FX (TV network)	Fargo	Fargo (TV series)	anthology	anthology series	black comedy	black comedy	crime drama	crime film	Noah Hawley	Noah Hawley

Its principal cast consisted of Kirsten Dunst , Patrick Wilson , Jesse Plemons , Jean Smart and Ted Danson .	Kirsten Dunst	Kirsten Dunst	Patrick Wilson	Patrick Wilson (American actor)	Jesse Plemons	Jesse Plemons	Jean Smart	Jean Smart	Ted Danson	Ted Danson
The season had ten episodes , and its initial airing concluded on December 14 , 2015 .
As an anthology , each Fargo season possesses its own self-contained narrative , following a disparate set of characters in various settings .	Fargo	Fargo (TV series)	anthology	anthology series

A prequel to the events in its first season , season two of Fargo takes place in the Midwestern United States in March 1979 .	Fargo	Fargo (TV series)	its first season	Fargo (season 1)	Midwestern United States	Midwestern United States

It follows the lives of a young couple -- Peggy -LRB- Dunst -RRB- and Ed Blumquist -LRB- Plemons -RRB- -- as they attempt to cover up the hit and run and murder of Rye Gerhardt -LRB- Kieran Culkin -RRB- , the son of Floyd Gerhardt -LRB- Smart -RRB- , matriarch of the Gerhardt crime family .	Peggy	Peggy Blumquist	hit and run	hit and run	Kieran Culkin	Kieran Culkin	Floyd Gerhardt	Floyd Gerhardt	crime family	crime family

During this time , Minnesota state trooper Lou Solverson -LRB- Wilson -RRB- , and Rock County sheriff Hank Larsson -LRB- Danson -RRB- , investigate three murders linked to Rye .	Minnesota state trooper	Minnesota State Patrol	Lou Solverson	Lou Solverson	Rock County	Rock County, Minnesota
Hawley and his writing team used the second season to expand the scope of the show 's storytelling .
Season two 's episodes were shot in Calgary , Alberta over an 85-day period .	Calgary	Calgary	Alberta	Alberta
The series received widespread critical acclaim and was cited as one of the strongest programs of the 2015 television season .

It was a candidate for a multitude of awards , including the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Limited Series and Golden Globe for Best Miniseries or Television Film , and won several other honors recognizing outstanding achievement in acting , directing , writing , cinematography , editing , special effects , and creative direction .
